description: Sample labelled questions for the document RAG pipeline. expected_files names files in documents/; the runner turns them into document ids after ingesting.

cases.question: What is the minimum attendance needed to write the semester exam?
cases.reference_answer: Students need a minimum of 75% attendance in every course to write the end semester examination.

cases.question: How do I apply for attendance condonation on medical grounds?
cases.reference_answer: Students between 65% and 75% attendance submit a medical certificate to the Head of Department within seven days and pay a condonation fee of Rs. 500.

cases.question: What is the late fee after the due date?
cases.reference_answer: A late fee of Rs. 100 per day applies after the due date, up to a maximum of Rs. 3,000.

cases.question: Is the tuition fee refunded if a student withdraws after classes begin?
cases.reference_answer: After classes begin, 50% of the tuition fee is refunded if the student withdraws within 15 days, and nothing after 15 days.

cases.question: How many books can postgraduate students borrow and for how long?
cases.reference_answer: Postgraduate students may borrow up to six books for 21 days.

cases.question: When do the hostel gates close on weekends?
cases.reference_answer: Hostel gates close at 10:30 pm on weekends.
